origin.description: Call disconnect() when the frame exits.
origin.details: R requires a DBIConnection and calls DBI::dbDisconnect. The translation calls disconnect() on the object.
origin.example:
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(DBI); library(RSQLite)})
path <- tempfile()
con0 <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), path)
DBI::dbExecute(con0, "CREATE TABLE t (x REAL)")
DBI::dbExecute(con0, "INSERT INTO t VALUES (1), (2)")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con0)
total <- local({
  con <- local_db_connection(DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), path))
  DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT SUM(x) AS s FROM t")$s
})
unlink(path)
total

translation.description: Call disconnect() when the frame exits.
translation.details: R requires a DBIConnection and calls DBI::dbDisconnect. The translation calls disconnect() on the object. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

import sqlite3
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
raw = sqlite3.connect(path)
raw.execute("CREATE TABLE t (x REAL)")
raw.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (1), (2)")
raw.commit()
raw.close()

class Conn:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.raw = sqlite3.connect(path)
        self.closed = False
    def disconnect(self):
        self.raw.close()
        self.closed = True

con = Conn(path)
with local_db_connection(con):
    total = con.raw.execute("SELECT SUM(x) FROM t").fetchone()[0]
os.remove(path)
return total
